## What this region is

External providers behind one stable interface: adapter modules with (pick by environment), (pick by key) and (fan out), the object-storage adapter, and the / models that connect an owner to a provider and its synced records. The app-event bus and webhooks that often call these live in.

## What it exists for

- Route a call to an external service's provider (by environment, key, tenant or all at once)
- Work with an owner's provider integration and its synced records
- Read or write stored files, or provision local buckets

## When this is not your domain

These mention this region's words but belong elsewhere; the answer is no, and the region named answers instead.

- Send an email or notification after this write → app-events-webhooks
- Send an email to the user → email-delivery
- Send an SMS → messaging-contacts
- Which redis connection do I use → redis-caching-rate-limits
